reader_notes: Short opinion piece; the Swedish is idiomatic and the closing two-sentence turn ('De blir bra av att nagon forst har fragat vem som ror sig var, och nar') lands without strain.

q1 option C is a precise near-miss: the passage says the complaints moved to other times of day ('andra tider pa dygnet'), not to other places in the city, so the distractor punishes exactly the skim a hurried reader would make.

q2 option B is defensible-sounding but overstated relative to the text, which says size mattered 'mindre an vantat', not that it lacked significance; the distinction is fine but the passage states it clearly enough to be fair.
